title: Matcha Making and Tasting at Junbi SF
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience a guided tasting of teas sourced from a 100-year-old farm in Uji, Japan. Explore a range of flavors—from traditional matcha to a dessert-style matcha—in a relaxed, approachable setting. This unique activity blends authentic tea culture with a casual vibe, making it perfect for team building, group outings, or a fun activity with friends.

Please note the minimum group is 7 and maximum is 15 guests.
